title: Candy
summary: Give each child at least one candy.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–50000 ratings, each in [0,50000]. Only immediate neighbors matter.
contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned int.

statement: Give each child at least one candy. A child with a strictly higher rating than an adjacent child must receive more candies than that neighbor. Equal ratings impose no ordering. Return the minimum total number of candies.

examples.explanation: Two candies for each end and one in the middle suffice.
All equal ratings can receive one candy each.

constraints: 1–50000 ratings, each in [0,50000]. Only immediate neighbors matter.
hints: Conceptual: A child may have requirements from both sides.
Directional: Compute the minimum imposed by each scan direction.
Implementation: Start with one candy per child. Increase counts along ascending runs, then scan backward and enforce the right-neighbor requirement without lowering an existing count.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(n) auxiliary space.
